about.title: About & safety
about.whatBody: JusticeNow lets anyone in Sri Lanka report a human rights violation anonymously and follow what happens next. It is aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goal 16 — peace, justice and strong institutions.
about.how1: Report what happened using a short, guided form. You never give your name.
about.how2: You receive a private reference code — a code like JN-XXXXXXXX that stands in for you.
about.how3: Come back any time and enter that code to check your case status and read any updates.
about.anonBody1: We never ask for your name, phone number, email or an account. There is nothing that ties a case to you — your reference code is the only link to it.
about.anonBody2: Because of this, we cannot recover a lost code, not even for you: we do not know who you are. Nothing about your case is saved on this device.
about.safetyBody: The Quick Exit button sits on every screen. One tap closes JusticeNow and clears anything you have typed. Write your reference code somewhere safe — and if this device is shared or not private, keep the code on something else.
about.footer: Aligned with UN SDG 16 · Peace, Justice & Strong Institutions
